mapper.sql: ar_agings.id AS id, ar_agings.date AS date, ar_agings.reference AS reference, customers.name AS customerName, (SELECT CONCAT(account_codes, '-',account_description) FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = ar_agings.deposit_to) AS chartAccountName, (SELECT SUM(paid) FROM ar_aging_details WHERE ar_aging_id = ar_agings.id) AS totalAmount, ar_agings.note AS note, ar_agings.exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, ar_agings.gl_id AS glId, ar_agings.cheque_number AS chequeNumber, (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = ar_agings.company_id) AS `companyName`, IFNULL(customers.name, '') AS customerName, ar_agings.account_codes AS accountCode
FROM ar_agings LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = ar_agings.customer_id LEFT JOIN ar_aging_details ON ar_aging_details.ar_aging_id = ar_agings.id
